notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id.

This is a SECOND, independent synthetic application (Meridian Radiology Systems, LLC, offering the CardioTrack CT-500) against the same true_requirements.json as data/36C26226Q1367 -- built to add SFT/eval training data with deliberately different failure and compliance shapes from the original application (Summit Diagnostic Equipment, LLC, offering the SonoRest CV-200).

The original application never included any salient-characteristics spec sheet for its offered product, so all 12 salient_char_* topics scored insufficient_information/non_compliant uniformly. This application includes a real spec sheet addressing all 12 characteristics individually, producing genuine per-item variety: 10 compliant matches, one clean numeric shortfall each on hand-control-loop count and backrest tilt range (non_compliant), one vague low-entry description with no confirmable number (insufficient_information), and one internal spec-sheet inconsistency between the summary table and the attached technical data sheet excerpt for the apical cutout dimensions (contradictory) -- a realistic vendor-literature mismatch rather than a bidder-authored contradiction.

authorized_distributor_letter, buy_american_certificate_completed, business_size_designation, or_equal_submission_requirements, and nmr_certification_signed are inverted to compliant (fully completed/attached) rather than the original's deferred-to-later or never-addressed pattern; country_of_origin_disclosure is a clean single compliant statement since that topic's contradiction shape is already the canonical example in the original application.
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone.

primary_verdict / primary_verdict_source (added by SFT data-prep pass): a single training-target label per topic, additive -- acceptable_verdicts is unchanged and remains the source of truth for verdict-accuracy scoring. primary_verdict is the pipeline's own correct prediction where one exists (source: pipeline_prediction), else acceptable_verdicts[0] (source: acceptable_verdicts_first). null for topics with acceptable_verdicts: null (excluded from SFT training, same as they're excluded from verdict scoring).
